test_inputs.explanation: Values were extracted from the encoded filter parameter in the agent's URLs (steps 5–6). The base64-encoded filter decodes to URL-encoded form data containing customer_id[from]=100, customer_id[to]=200, firstname=John, email=john.doe@example.com, last_activity[from]=2026-02-01 00:00:00, last_activity[to]=2026-02-02 23:59:59, type=c and last_url=/checkout/cart. Other fields left empty because they were not present in the recorded requests.
